review_description: I was also going to go with Jon Caldwell in Wagga but Craig was cheaper with the same system. Both of them provide EXCELLENT customer service.

The installer disuaded me from having an on-ground setup in the open paddock 50mtrs away, and set the panels at a less than optimum angle (ie same as the roof pitch). They did not make it clear to me that I would incur extra costs to get a net meter installed. I am ok with these matters  but it made for a less than perfect score. All in all a pretty good deal - cheaper than I had previously reckoned.
